name: source-check
cmd: set -e; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; bun x oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --disable-nested-config core/count-recovery/derivability-closure.ts core/count-recovery/derivability-closure.test.ts core/count-focused.ts core/count-focused.test.ts core/count-focus-proof.ts; bun test core/count-recovery/derivability-closure.test.ts core/count-focused.test.ts core/count-focus-proof.test.ts

name: equal-row
cmd: set -e; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; LAB_ROW_MODE=equal LAB_SOURCE_MS=1500 LAB_SOURCE_TRACE=1 bun research/track-m/active-source-probe.ts replay-input/input.json 'Inv*' 5 all

name: active-rows
cmd: set -e; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; LAB_SOURCE_MS=5000 LAB_SOURCE_TRACE=1 bun research/track-m/active-source-probe.ts replay-input/input.json 'Inv*' 5 all
